Camera report

Definition

Camera report is a per-roll or per-card record of clips, takes, technical settings, notes and media identifiers from camera. In a controlled workflow, its owner, version and acceptance evidence should be recorded.

Why it matters

This concept helps production teams align production decisions, handoffs and verification without relying on unstated assumptions.

Related terms

  • Prelight
  • Sound report
